chapters.title: LIFE SAVING SIGNALS
For use by Ships, Aircraft or Persons
in Distress when communicating
with Rescue Units
The signals illustrated in this
leaflet are those to be used by
any ship or person in distress
when communicating with search
and rescue units. They have been
agreed internationally for this
purpose and it is important that
you are familiar with them to
ensure they are correctly used
The International Convention for
the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS)
in Regulation 29 of Chapter V
requires you to have access to
this table. You are advised to keep
a copy on board, or if this is not
practicable, at least to study the
